reason: pm2 cluster mode (-i N) is node:cluster inside the pm2 daemon: cluster.fork() runs the daemon runtime (Node) and ignores --interpreter, and pm2 only defaults to cluster_mode when the interpreter path contains node — with --interpreter bun, -i N silently runs the instances in fork_mode (N plain processes, no cluster, no port sharing). Forcing exec_mode cluster_mode runs the workers under Node, not Bun.
verified: live on this box: pm2 -i 2 --interpreter <bun> reports exec_mode fork_mode; a forced cluster_mode config spawns Node workers that crash-loop on Bun APIs
